findings: learner.overview.text: This centers the uncertain grains proposal while leaving the better-supported formation disagreement out of the first-reading explanation. Lead with the received analysis—smallness plus a proposed sound element—and briefly note that early 少 and 小 overlapped and some analyses instead treat the graph as a picture of fine grains; keep the referent uncertain. Cite E3, X-3e7c7db97d01891137c7, X-519d63d819029d5b5600, X-8487cd1cb9ca11b26969.
